skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of descriptive and inferential statistics to analyze data and support decision-making.
Understand and apply basic concepts of probability theory to support decision-making in uncertain environments.
Understand and apply methods of statistical inference to draw general conclusions from data.
Use software tools to visualize data, perform statistical analysis, and generate reports to support decision-making.
Develop independent learning skills, work independently and in groups, and take personal and group responsibility.
